__broaden__.jen: -(i)jen — reflexive-possessive, one's own (front-vowel form; the token left after köġüd(i)-; here 'her own') [子每(自的)行] · also after ger-tür(i)- (dative-locative), 'one's own home' · also after ökin(i)-, 'one's own daughter' · also after kekül(i)- ('one's own tuft'), šibülgel(i)- ('one's own braid') and nidün-dür(i)- ('in one's own eye'), and after the accusative in žeġüdün-(n)i-jen (token ni-jen) · also after bergen(i)- ('one's own sister-in-law') and deġü-ner(i)- ('one's own younger brothers'), where the (i) is Shiratori's accusative; also after köġün(i)- ('one's own son') and ökid(i)- ('one's own daughters') · also -(i)jen after esüg(i)- ('one's own ripe mare's milk') and after -dür(i)- ('to one's own', ulus irgen -dür(i)-jen) · also after emeġel(i)- ('one's own saddle') · also after hüker(i)- ('one's own ox'), güžüġün-dür(i)-, ebčeġün-dür(i)- ('at one's own neck, chest') and üge-dür(i)- ('in one's own word') · also after ösül(i)- ('one's own enmity'), ebür(i)- ('one's own bosom'), čeriġüd(i)- ('one's own troops') and deġel(i)- ('one's own robe') · also after üges-tür(i)- ('in one's own words'), nököd(i)- ('one's own companions'), helige-ber(i)- ('prone, lying', analysis uncertain) and plain tür(i)- ('in one's own')
__broaden__.jar: -jar — instrumental: with, by means of (case suffix; the token left after moṅgirsun(i)-; the Ming 敎 marks the means) [薤敎] · also in jabuγad(i)-jar, 'on foot' (Ming 步行着, the whole word; the token left after jabuγad(i)-, analysis uncertain) · also after arasun(i)- ('with the hide', Ming 皮子敎), where the (i) is Shiratori's · also after Turqaγ̇ud(i)- (a mountain name; Ming 依着), 'along, by way of the Turqaqud'
__broaden__.jan: -(i)jan — reflexive-possessive, one's own (back-vowel form; the token left after γažar-tur(i)- and γažar(i)-) [地 自的行] · also after aqui-dur(i)- (a participle with dative-locative) · also after quruγ̇ud(i)-, 'one's own fingers' (a plural noun with the accusative i; Ming 指頭 自的行) · also after tergen-dur(i)- ('to one's own cart'), amin(i)- ('one's own life', accusative), γar-tur(i)- ('in one's own hand') and niγ̇ur-tur(i)- ('in one's own face'), where the (i) is Shiratori's · also after oin-dur(i)- ('in one's own mind') and morin(i)- ('one's own horse', accusative), where the (i) is Shiratori's · also after aγ̇ur(i)- ('one's own breath, rage'), botoγan(i)- ('one's own camel foal') and turγaγ̇ud(i)- ('one's own companions'), where the (i) is Shiratori's · also -(i)jan after kituγai-jar(i)- (instrumental, 'with one's own knife') · also after tuk(i)- ('one's own banner'), qurdun(i)- and dun(i)- ('one's own fast horse'), qujag(i)- ('one's own armour') and sumun(i)- ('one's own arrow'), where the (i) is Shiratori's · also after bolulčaγsan(i)- (a past participle with the accusative, 'what they had done together, their own'; Ming 共 做了的 自的行) and after jor(i)- ('his own sounding arrowhead'; the Ming 自的 has no 行), where the (i) is Shiratori's · also after Uruγ̇ud(i)- and Moṅγud(i)- (people names; Ming 一種 自的行), 'one's own Uruqud, one's own Mongqud'
__broaden__.na: -(n)a — dative-locative: at, in, to (back-vowel form) [行] · also a particle na (Ming 好生 'well, very'; sense uncertain), in bolγaqu na žöb, 'to be made, na, right' (§126)
__broaden__.qarin: qarin — back, again (adverb; Ming 回) [囘] · also 'tribe, division' (Ming 部 'division, section'; sense uncertain), in harban γurban qarin, 'thirteen divisions'
__broaden__.žüg: žüg — direction, side, place; after a name, 'toward' (noun used as a postposition) [處] · also žüg, 'each' (repeated: 'each each') (Ming 各 'each'), in the entrusting of the posts
__broaden__.üžin: Üžin — Üjin, a woman's name, or the second part of women's names (Högelün-Üžin, Γoγ̇a-Üžin), also alone in Üžin eke 'Mother Üjin' (noun, name element) [婦人名] · also 'lady' (Ming 夫人), a title after a woman's name, as in Höġelün Üžin
__broaden__.bürün: bü- — to be; converb -rün, 'being' (verb, converb; Ming (有)的) [(有)的] · also 'as for, being' after či (Ming 呵), 'as for you' · also after ergi-de and the like, 'being, having been' (Ming 有來) · also 'dwelling' (Ming 住着)
__broaden__.deġermedčü: deġermed- — to rob, raid (from deġerme; stem inferred); converb -čü, 'robbing' (verb, converb) [劫着] · also with the Ming 被 as a passive, 'being plundered' (被搶着)
__broaden__.nekežü: neke- — to pursue, chase (stem inferred from the Ming 追趕); converb -žü, 'pursuing' (verb, converb) [追趕著︀] · also 'attacking' (Ming 襲着 'attack'; stem uncertain)
__broaden__.köġüd-i: köġüd-i — the sons, as object (köġün + plural -d + accusative -i) [子每(行)] · also 'the princes' as object (Ming 大王每(行)), of the Činos princes
__broaden__.žamuqa-da: Žamuqa — Jamuqa, a man's name; dative-locative -da, 'to Jamuqa' (personal name + case, back-vowel form) [人名 行] · also after a passive, naming the agent: 'by Jamuqa'
__broaden__.teriġüten: teriġü — head; plural possessive -ten, 'those having heads, the headed ones' (noun + plural possessive; uncertain: the Ming 項每 has 項 'neck' or 'item, kind' (perhaps 頭項 'headman'), so 'chiefs' and 'branches' are both only readings) [項每] · also with the Ming 等項 'and the like', 'X and the other headmen' (項 'item' or 'neck', 等 'and so on') · also with the Ming 等項 'and the rest', after a name: Žamuqa teriġüten, 'Jamuqa and those headed by him' (uncertain)
